newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: GOODS TRAFFIC BY RAILWAY 12.3PCT UP IN JAN-APR.
newsitem.headline: GOODS TRAFFIC BY RAILWAY 12.3PCT UP IN JAN-APR.

text.p: Lithuania's statistics department said on Wednesday that the volume of goods transported by public railways in the country in the first four months of 1997 was 9.21 million tonnes, a 12.3 percent increase over the corresponding period in 1996.
The volume of goods transported domestically was 1.02 million tonnes, a 3.2 percent increase over the same period in 1996, the department said in a statement.

The volume of international goods transported by railway in the first four months of the year increased by 13.5 percent over the corresponding period in 1996 and amounted to 8.19 million tonnes, the statement added.
